description: A slew limiter that smooths the eight held voltages of SHEight, one row for each; it goes immediately to the right of SHEight

params.text: Sets the curve of that row's slew: a steady rate at one end of its travel, and at the other a rate that falls away as the output nears the new voltage
Sets how fast that row's output climbs to a higher voltage: 1ms per 10V fully anticlockwise, 10ms at the default, 100 seconds fully clockwise, measured with Shape at zero
Sets how fast that row's output falls to a lower voltage: 1ms per 10V fully anticlockwise, 10ms at the default, 100 seconds fully clockwise, measured with Shape at zero

outputs.text: The slewed voltage of that row of SHEight; the slew for the row runs only while a cable is in this jack

notes: nothing happens unless SHEight is the module immediately to the left; the ACTIVE lamp is lit while it is, and dark while it is not
a row is slewed only while a cable is in that row's output jack, so the knobs for a row with an empty jack change nothing
